purpose: New 2026 compact AI systems and unusual memory-extension platforms relevant to local LLM inference. Vendor performance claims are retained as vendor evidence and are not treated as independent benchmarks.

hardware.cpu: Snapdragon X2 Elite X2E-88-100, 3rd Gen Qualcomm Oryon, 18 cores
hardware.storage: dual M.2 2280 NVMe; one PCIe Gen5 and one PCIe Gen4 slot; up to 4TB total per ASUS datasheet
hardware.quantization_compatibility: Model/runtime specific through Qualcomm AI Hub/QNN. Do not assume arbitrary GGUF quantization executes on the Hexagon NPU; CPU/GPU paths may differ by runtime.

llm_suitability.practical_guidance: 32GB capacity is suitable for many 7B-14B quantized models and selected larger heavily-quantized workloads, but usable memory is shared with the OS and accelerators. NPU acceleration depends on model conversion/runtime support.

hardware.efficiency_notes: Compact ARM system with an 80-TOPS NPU and LPDDR5X. The 180W adapter is a supply rating, not measured wall draw; independent whole-system LLM power measurements are still needed.

pricing.note: ASUS Canada and US product pages are live, but no stable public purchase price was verified in this research pass.

hardware.storage: one M.2 NVMe SSD, up to 2TB in Lenovo PSREF
hardware.quantization_compatibility: CPU and GPU inference can use runtime-supported low-bit formats; OpenVINO/NPU execution is model and operator dependent. Do not infer that the 50-TOPS NPU accelerates arbitrary GGUF models.

llm_suitability.practical_guidance: 32GB shared memory makes 7B-14B quantized local models realistic and leaves some room for larger low-bit experiments. Shared-memory bandwidth and runtime maturity will matter more than headline TOPS for autoregressive decode.

hardware.efficiency_notes: Lenovo specifies a 45W processor TDP and 100W adapter. This is a compact, potentially efficient integrated-GPU/NPU node, but independent wall-power LLM benchmarks are required before assigning a measured performance-per-watt score.

pricing.note: Lenovo Australia indexed Yoga Mini 01IPH11 configurations from A$2,099; exact processor/RAM/storage mapping should be rechecked at purchase time.

hardware.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395, 16 cores, boost up to 5.1GHz
hardware.storage: 2x M.2 Key M PCIe Gen4 x4, RAID 0/1
hardware.cooling: fanned enclosure; six-heat-pipe thermal architecture with copper base per manufacturer
software: ROCm/Vulkan paths subject to platform support
hardware.quantization_compatibility: Unified-memory capacity is well suited to GGUF low-bit inference through compatible CPU/GPU runtimes; ROCm support and exact GPU offload behavior must be verified against runtime and driver versions.

llm_suitability.practical_guidance: 128GB unified memory makes 70B-class 4-bit models practical and allows experiments with larger quantized models. Actual decode speed depends strongly on memory bandwidth, GPU offload/runtime support, context length and quantization.

hardware.efficiency_notes: Large unified memory avoids discrete-GPU VRAM limits, but the 400W AC input rating is not measured workload draw. Compare measured wall power against other Ryzen AI Max+ 395 systems before assigning an efficiency rank.

pricing.note: ASRock Industrial exposes product inquiry/distributor channels but no stable public MSRP was verified.

hardware.architecture: software-managed flash/cache memory extension for AI workloads on PC/workstation platforms

vendor_claims: Desktop workstation configurations are positioned for models up to 100B.
Phison reported a 120B MoE workload handled with 32GB DRAM instead of 96GB traditional memory in its testing.
ASRock Industrial and Phison demonstrated a 120B model using 64GB system memory plus 85GB aiDAPTIV cache at Computex 2026.
llm_suitability.caveat: These are vendor demonstrations/claims, not independent normalized LLM benchmarks. Flash-backed memory extension is not equivalent to VRAM/HBM and can introduce workload-dependent latency and bandwidth penalties.

hardware.quantization_compatibility: Depends on the aiDAPTIVPro model/runtime workflow and partner configuration; do not assume transparent compatibility with every GGUF/AWQ/GPTQ runtime.

pricing.configuration: desktop PC class, positioned for up to 13B models
desktop workstation class, positioned for up to 100B models
